departures.visitor_applicability: Yes — venue/service-level, applies to a trans visitor; but the authoring body is national (England and Wales) and the guidance duplicates the national single-sex-spaces guidance.

departures.visitor_applicability: Only if a visitor is detained; the same litigation is already recorded at national level and its outcome is unresolved.
